name: task-inject
category: Workflow · Runtime feedback injection → checkpoint drain → acknowledged application
description: Inject modification feedback and adjustment instructions into a task the agent is already executing. Instructions are appended to a repo's .injects/inbox/ at any time (atomic writes, safe mid-run) and drained at fixed checkpoints. Four severity levels (halt, redirect, revise, note) decide whether the current step finishes, stops at the next tool boundary, or the direction is re-planned. Every application is acknowledged with evidence and appended to an audit log; halt requires a note, ids are never reused, and check --strict gates CI on a drained inbox. Directory is the single source of state; gates are enforced by a standard-library Python script.
